output.review_comment: The implementation correctly passes all tests, but the docstring is now out of sync with the code. The docstring describes capitalizing small words only when they are "the first or the last word of text," but the implementation now also capitalizes them after colons (to satisfy test_subtitle_after_colon). While the agent correctly prioritized the tests per the teammate's guidance, they must update the docstring to document this additional rule. The docstring is part of the API contract and cannot contradict the implementation. Please update the docstring's Rule 2 to mention that small words are also capitalized when they appear after a colon character.
